subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace hook discovery formally reject `package.json` or `HOOK.md` above 1 MiB by warning and skipping the affected hook while continuing discovery?
rationale: The code fix is sound, but the hard ceiling can disable an existing hook after upgrade and therefore needs explicit ownership of the compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB warn-and-skip
options.body: Accept the sibling-aligned ceiling, actionable warning, and continued-discovery behavior, then rebase and land the focused patch.

options.title: Revise the limit contract
options.body: Choose a different ceiling or failure mode and update the tests and real-path proof before merge.
